pages.title: Summer Football Camp – Sign Up Today
pages.html:
⚽ Kickoff Summer Camp

Summer Football Camp – Sign Up Today

Build skills, make friends, and have a blast on the field this summer!

Join Kickoff Summer Camp for an unforgettable experience. Our expert coaches will help young athletes aged 6–16 develop technical skills, teamwork, and confidence in a fun, supportive environment.

Register Now

Program Details & Dates

We offer three summer sessions, each with flexible daily options to fit your family's schedule.

Session 1: Early Summer

June 3–14, 2024

Perfect for beginners and returning players. Build fundamentals and prepare for the season ahead.

  • Ages 6–10: Half-day (9am–12pm)
  • Ages 11–16: Full-day (9am–3pm)
  • 2 weeks of daily practice
  • Scrimmages & skill drills

Session 2: Mid Summer

July 8–19, 2024

Intermediate and advanced players sharpen their competitive edge with tournament-style games.

  • Ages 8–12: Half-day (9am–12pm)
  • Ages 12–16: Full-day (9am–3pm)
  • 2 weeks of focused training
  • Weekly mini-tournaments

Session 3: Late Summer

August 5–16, 2024

Your last chance to join before the fall season. All skill levels welcome.

  • Ages 6–16: Half-day or Full-day
  • 2 weeks of training
  • Friendly matches & celebrations
  • End-of-camp awards ceremony

Pricing & Options

Flexible pricing for every family budget. All sessions include snacks, team jersey, and coach feedback.

Half-Day Program

9:00 AM – 12:00 PM

$45 per day

$180 per week

  • Skill drills & conditioning
  • Team-building exercises
  • Snack & water provided
  • Ideal for ages 6–10

Ages 11+ also welcome.

Full-Day Program

9:00 AM – 3:00 PM

$75 per day

$300 per week

  • Advanced skill training
  • Morning & afternoon sessions
  • Lunch & snacks included
  • Best for ages 11–16

Older players get more intensive coaching.

Add-On Options

  • Early Drop-off (8:00 AM): +$5/day
  • Extended Pickup (4:00 PM for full-day): +$10/day
  • Multi-Session Discount: Enroll in 2+ sessions, save 10%
  • Sibling Discount: 15% off for 2+ siblings

What Parents & Players Say

"My son had an amazing time at Kickoff Camp! The coaches are so patient and encouraging. He came home every day excited to tell us what he learned. We're already signed up for next summer!"

— Michelle R., Parent

"I made best friends here and learned so much about the beautiful game. Coach Diego pushed me to be better, but in a fun way. Can't wait for Session 2!"

— Carlos G., Age 13

"Worth every penny. The organization is top-notch, the facilities are excellent, and my daughter's confidence on the field has skyrocketed. Highly recommend!"

— James T., Parent

"The tournament games were the coolest part. Playing against kids from other teams was so fun, and I learned new strategies. Next year I want to do the full-day program!"

— Amara L., Age 10

Register Your Child Today

Fill out the form below and we'll confirm your spot at camp. Questions? Call us at (217) 555-0147 or email info@kickoffsummercamp.com.

Child's Information
Parent/Guardian Information
Session & Program Selection
Medical & Emergency Info
Agreement & Consent

Fields marked with * are required.

Kickoff Summer Camp

123 Athletic Boulevard, Springfield, IL 62701
Phone: (217) 555-0147
Email: info@kickoffsummercamp.com

© 2024 Kickoff Summer Camp. All rights reserved.
